venues.name: D&C DC
venues.weather: Little chilly, but overall a nice night
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Friday 2/13.** Garden: smooth; Jada and Sophia provided great service, many guests used the space while waiting for a Marquee table; Jada cut, Sophia handled last call and close. Marquee: steady and full until after midnight; natural last call, last guests left shortly after 2am; great teamwork. Comps $375.34 (service recovery, employee, investor, DNL, gift). Kitchen: busy; James handled BOH. MOD: Cory / Kevin.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Friday 2/13.** Quick-paced, smooth evening with increasingly chaotic vibes; waitlist cleared by midnight, key large parties later. Plenty of tiramisu sold (may need more spoons). Comps $200. Top sellers: Masari, Year of the Trees, Trust Fall. Door: Valentine's Day eve; bar full at 6:30, good 8pm push of reservations and walk-ins, leaned toward larger groups; 10pm onward hectic; two guests who agreed to stand then took T11 and left, one returned and apologized; prioritized employee friends, industry and investors, hitting some red waits; a party of 7 kept adding/subtracting near last call. No no-shows. Kitchen: none.
